title: ABBA Operational Safety Envelope
rules: Safety is evaluated before consequential execution.
Safety disposition does not authorize execution.
A budget ceiling is not a permission grant.
A circuit breaker may hold or block work without changing authority.
Retries are bounded and never override execution idempotency.
Blast radius must be bounded and preferably split into recoverable steps.
Data egress is explicitly budgeted and minimized.
Irreversible actions require an explicit reversibility or compensation path unless separately governed.
Safety evidence remains distinct from authority and truth.
